project_type: Single-module Android TV (leanback) application POC — SceneVibe TV Companion. Java, built with Android Gradle Plugin.
language: Java (Android), with Python 3 boundary tests and PowerShell helper scripts.
build_system: Gradle + Android Gradle Plugin 8.7.3 (declared in root build.gradle, apply false). NO Gradle wrapper in repo; CI installs gradle 8.9 via gradle/actions/setup-gradle. Root settings.gradle rootProject 'SceneVibeTvCompanionPoc', include ':app'. gradle.properties sets jvmargs + android.useAndroidX=true.
test_framework: JVM unit tests via JUnit 4.13.2 (+ org.json:json for test-only JSON), run as :app:testDebugUnitTest with testOptions.unitTests.returnDefaultValues=true. Python boundary tests in tests/test_poc_contract.py via `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
build_command: LOCAL (qualified in sandbox): export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2; gradle :app:assembleDebug (gradle 8.14.5 on PATH via mise). CI uses gradle 8.9 on ubuntu-latest.
test_command: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests  AND  gradle :app:testDebugUnitTest (with ANDROID_HOME + JAVA_HOME 17 set as above).
verification_instructions: Mirror the existing android-debug.yml gates: python boundary tests, assembleDebug, lintDebug, testDebugUnitTest, LAN DEV build (SCENEVIBE_ENABLE_LAN_DEV=true), Cloud qualification build (SCENEVIBE_CLOUD_ORIGIN=https://interface-scenevibe-3wxg.vercel.app). PLUS the new release gates: assembleRelease, release-non-debuggable validation (aapt dump badging / manifest shows no android:debuggable), signature validation only when the four signing secrets are present (they are NOT present locally). The signed-release production chain is CI-only (needs GitHub repo secrets).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. app/build/ is gitignored. assembleDebug produces app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; assembleRelease will produce app/build/outputs/apk/release/*.apk (unsigned until apksigner signs it in CI). No generated sources are committed.
setup_instructions: export JAVA_HOME=/root/.local/share/mise/installs/java/17.0.2 (JDK 17 required by AGP 8.7.3 / JavaVersion.VERSION_17). Android SDK installed locally at /opt/android-sdk (cmdline-tools 19.0, platforms;android-35, build-tools;35.0.0, platform-tools). export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk. gradle 8.14.5 is on PATH via mise shims; AGP resolves online from Google Maven (OPEN_INTERNET).
environment_constraints: Network: OPEN_INTERNET (Google Maven + Android SDK repo reachable; the convenience alias commandline-tools-linux_latest.zip 404s — use the real repository2-3.xml filenames commandlinetools-linux-<build>_latest.zip). Local gradle is 8.14.5 and default JDK is 25; AGP 8.7.3 needs JDK 17 (available via mise at 17.0.2) — ALWAYS set JAVA_HOME to 17. KNOWN SANDBOX QUIRK: :app:lintDebug FAILS locally under gradle 8.14.5 with an IntelliJ/UAST MessageBusImpl 'Already disposed' error inside AndroidLintWorkAction — this is a lint-runtime/Gradle-version incompatibility, NOT a code defect. assembleDebug and testDebugUnitTest PASS locally. lint is green on CI (gradle 8.9). Try pinning gradle 8.9 locally (gradle/actions equivalent) to qualify lint; if it still fails locally, record lint as CI-ONLY and do not weaken it. No Android emulator/AVD and no KVM locally — the Android 15 emulator smoke test is CI-ONLY (GitHub Actions reactivecircus/android-emulator-runner). adb/apksigner ARE available locally at /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools and /opt/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0.
contribution_requirements: HARD INTERDICTIONS (do NOT modify): MediaSyncedTrackScheduler.java and MediaIdentityMatcher.java (unless a demonstrated API-35 necessity), FinalTrack logic, scenevibe.track.v1 format, Cloud API, device proof, installation recovery, Reset Cloud, account ownership, pairing protocol, SceneVibe pipeline, LLM prompts, web interface, Vercel/Neon, Clerk. No new product features, no Banner, no WebSocket, no FCM, no package rename, no massive cosmetic refactor. Do NOT delete any existing test or weaken any assertion. NEVER invent/generate/commit/log any private key, password, or keystore. Never label a CI/emulator result as 'physically qualified'.
key_patterns: FGS is foregroundServiceType=specialUse (NOT in Android 15's BOOT_COMPLETED-restricted list of dataSync/camera/mediaPlayback/phoneCall/mediaProjection/microphone), so the boot-prepare startForegroundService path remains permitted on API 35. BootReceiver already wraps everything fail-closed and uses startForegroundService; OverlayService.onCreate calls startForeground promptly then checks Settings.canDrawOverlays. 'armed != visible' Consumer Mode: overlay drawn lazily only when a comment is due. PendingIntent already uses FLAG_IMMUTABLE. BuildConfig fields CLOUD_ORIGIN + ENABLE_LAN_DEV come from env vars validated in app/build.gradle (cloud origin must match /https:\/\/[^\/:?#]+/). Existing android-debug.yml exposes SIGNING_ENABLED boolean and signs the DEBUG apk when all four secrets exist — the audit must NOT treat that debug-signed apk as a production release.
directory_structure: Root: build.gradle, settings.gradle, gradle.properties, README.md, .gitignore. .github/workflows/android-debug.yml (only CI). app/ (single module): app/build.gradle, app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml, app/src/main/java/com/scenevibe/tvcompanionpoc/*.java (26 source files incl. OverlayService, BootReceiver, MainActivity, MediaSessionAccessService, CloudControlClient, MediaSyncedTrackScheduler, MediaIdentityMatcher), app/src/main/res/ (drawable + values/strings.xml), app/src/test/java/com/scenevibe/tvcompanionpoc/*Test.java (17 JVM test files). docs/ (qualification docs incl. tv-recovery-0.8.1.md). scripts/ (PowerShell helpers). tests/test_poc_contract.py. examples/ fixtures.
